item.title: Vinyl Matinee Sundays — Sun Oct 25, 5:00 PM — London Irish Centre
item.description:
A great lineup of powerhouse UK djs for your dancing pleasure! Join a fun-filled salsa early evening with the finest tunes! *** Sunday early evening with quality salsa on vinyl on the very spacious and fully air-conditioned McNamara Hall on the London Irish Centre, Camden. Looking forward to dancing with you and sharing the joy of salsa! Great variety of drinks, best Guinness in town and hot and cold beverages to accompany your Sunday salsa dose! PLEASE NOTE: – Bring your own water bottle for refill (the venue will be providing a plastic cup per person for reuse on the night to minimise single-usage cups) – We have over-the-shoe socks that make dancing on the wood floor very smooth and spinning very easy. You can try them at the door and if you like how they feel, purchase for £2. They protect your dance shoes and also make any hard floor easy to spin on. Wash and use over and over again VENUE: The London Irish Centre, 50-52 Camden Square, London, NW1 9XB
Source: Go Latin Dance

Whether you're a film nerd, popcorn enthusiast, or just looking for a chill night out with interesting people — this one's for you.
We’re heading out to see a movie together, then grabbing food or drinks after. If the film's great (or terrible), we’ll probably talk about it forever. If it’s just okay, we’ll talk about it for 10 minutes and move on to everything else — books, dating apps, weird dreams, how Toronto keeps getting more expensive, etc.

Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🎃🍂 Halloween Day: The Fall Colours of High Park & Ghost Stories 👻
### Fall Colours, Spooky Stories & A Little Halloween Fun
It's Halloween — so why should the ghosts get to have all the fun at night?
Join us for a **Halloween Day walk through High Park**, where we'll enjoy the fall colours while stopping along the way for some of the park's stranger, spookier, and downright weird stories. High Park has a long history of ghost stories and local legends.
From stories connected to the **War of 1812** — yes, *that* War of 1812 — to tales of mysterious deaths and people who may not have completely left the park behind, there's plenty of history to make an ordinary fall walk a little more interesting. But don't worry.
**This isn't a terrifying ghost hunt.**
